manual.p: Sometimes we want to inherit from two or more classes. This works in Pike (and in C++, but not in Java). You just write several inherits.
Lets say we have a class friend, that represents a friend:
A hamster, as we all know, is both an animal and a friend, and it can also dance:
manual.pi: hamster h = hamster("Blue Lightning", 0.12); h->cuddle(); // Cuddle as a friend h->eat("grain"); // Eat as an animal h->dance(); // Dance as a hamster
